Ellen S.: heads-up: invoice-preview surfaced small but consistent rounding diffs (~0.6%) for token counts on requests that used the new js-sdk tokenizer
Vikram J.: rough hypothesis: frontend tokenizer and backend token-counter disagree on edge unicode cases or sentencepiece variants. do we have sample payloads?
Ellen S.: yes. sample request_id r-xy7: sdk tokens=124, backend tokens=127, billed_tokens=127 -> delta shows up in preview aggregates
Nadia P.: that mismatch could cascade. product already noticed a customer note. how widespread?
Ellen S.: query across previews shows ~180 tenants with >0.4% delta in last 7 days, concentrated on embed-heavy and multi-lang routes
MeteringBot: alert: tokenization-mismatch-rate increased 320% link: https://console/redwood/metering/alerts/19921
Vikram J.: quick mitigations: 1) normalize token counting by sending sdk_token_count in request metadata and use as authoritative in preview path 2) add a preview-only reconciliation that prefers sdk count when present
Nadia P.: sending sdk_token_count helps previews, but we can't trust client counts for live billing without verification. product will want an audit trail if we start using client-sent counts in previews
Ellen S.: proposal: implement preview-only flag `use_sdk_token_count_in_preview=true` scoped to a tenant cohort; add an invoice-preview card showing "sdk vs server token delta" and an audit link to example requests
Vikram J.: +1. also add a nightly job to sample and re-run tokenization server-side for requests that report sdk_count to measure drift. small script: ```for req in sample: server_count=reqanalyze(req.text); emit(req.id, sdk=req.sdk_count, server=server_count)```
ProductOps: product wants to avoid surprising customers. please include an explanatory note in preview UI: "Preview may use client-reported token counts for investigational purposes only." Also include a link to support playbook
Ellen S.: agreed. I'll scope canary to tenants [t-700,t-701,t-702] and run diffs. if deltas drop significantly and sample audits match, we can expand preview and then decide on long-term fix (sdk spec or server tokenizer alignment)
DeployBot: task created: MTR-1805 preview opt-in sdk token-count reconciliation - assigned to Vikram J. - due 2026-07-04
Vikram J.: starting work on feature flag + preview card. will emit traces `token.count.source=sdk|server` for sampled requests
Nadia P.: can you also add a dashboard heatmap for language vs delta? looks like non-latin scripts show higher mismatch in initial samples
Ellen S.: flipping canary now for [t-700,t-701,t-702] :rocket:
DeployBot: preview flag toggled for tenants t-700,t-701,t-702 by Ellen S.
Ellen S.: (after) preview diffs: t-700 delta down 0.45%, t-701 down 0.62%, t-702 down 0.58%. sample audit job showed server vs sdk counts match within 1-2 tokens for 92% of samples. proceeding to expand preview and raise RFC to standardize tokenizer spec across SDKs and server. :white_check_mark:
